raw_context:
Farmacias La Economía (and related regional entities like
Droguería La Economía
) operates primarily as a major pharmaceutical retailer and distributor, stocking multi-brand consumer healthcare goods, OTC medicines, and personal care lines from top national and international manufacturing partners.

Product Categories & Featured Brands
Over-the-Counter (OTC) & Relief:
Advil, Aflamax, Apiret, Asaprol.
Vitamins & Supplements:
Benet (Magnesium gummies), Miovit, Funat (Collagen and Biotin), Emulsión de Scott.
Nutrition & Baby Care:
PediaSure, major infant formulas, and pediatric lines.
Personal Care & Hygiene:
Dove, Head & Shoulders, Nosotras.
